newsitem.title: USA: Oxford to enter holistic medicine - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Oxford to enter holistic medicine - WSJ.

text.p: Oxford Health Plans Inc is expected to announce this week its first provider network for alternative medicine like Chinese herbology, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The newspaper said the company would announce plans to set up a network of 1,000 holistic providers similar to the one for its 33,000 traditional doctors.
The services would become available in January in New York, Connecticut and New Jersey, it said.
Oxford Health hoped to tap into a $50 billion market, it added.
